gloss: to equip; to attach; to put on (equipment, device)

definitions.gloss: to equip; to attach; to put on; to install
definitions.explanation: To put on or attach equipment, a device, or gear to a person or object. Used for functional items like helmets, lenses, parts, or devices, not for everyday clothing.

examples.japanese: ヘルメットを{装着|そうちゃく}する。
シートベルトを{正|ただ}しく{装着|そうちゃく}してください。
このカメラには{特殊|とくしゅ}なレンズが{装着|そうちゃく}されていて、{暗|くら}い{場所|ばしょ}でも{撮影|さつえい}できる。
examples.english: This camera has a special lens attached, so it can take photos even in dark places.

notes:
Used for functional equipment and devices, not for regular clothing. Implies a deliberate, often technical act of attaching or equipping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヘルメットを{装着|そうちゃく}する — to put on a helmet
- マスクを{装着|そうちゃく}する — to put on a mask
- {部品|ぶひん}を{装着|そうちゃく}する — to attach a part
- {装着|そうちゃく}{方法|ほうほう} — how to attach/equip
- {装着|そうちゃく}{済|ず}み — already equipped/installed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着|つ}ける — to put on, attach (general); the everyday equivalent
- {取|と}り{付|つ}ける — to install, mount; focuses on physical attachment of hardware
- {身|み}に{着|つ}ける — to wear, to put on (clothing or accessories)
- {着用|ちゃくよう}する — to wear (formal); used for clothing, uniforms, protective gear
